# The full running list, rendered. This is what early-career folks see on
# GitHub (extended-cv.md at the repo root). Render with: Rscript build.R extended
title: ""
bibliography: [../data/publications.bib, ../data/reports.bib]
csl: ../assets/science.csl
nocite: "@*"
output:
  md_document:
    variant: gfm-raw_html
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    includes:
      in_header: ../assets/preamble.tex
geometry: margin=0.75in
fontsize: 10pt
mainfont: Carlito
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "..", "R", "cv.R"))
cv <- load_cv()
cv$private <- list()   # the public page never shows private fields
```

```{r}
render_header(cv)
p <- cv$profile
cat("[GitHub](https://github.com/", p$github, ") | [ORCID](https://orcid.org/", p$orcid,
    ") | [Google Scholar](", p$scholar, ") | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/", p$linkedin, ")\n\n", sep = "")
cat("*Last updated ", format(Sys.Date(), "%B %Y"), ". This is my running list of everything I've done, ",
    "kept public so early-career folks can see what a nonlinear science career looks like. ",
    "See the [README](README.md) for how it's built.*\n\n", sep = "")
```
